_comment: Reprise (CR 8.4.3) is an EXISTING condition; the card invented REPRISE_FLAG. The reprise half was also ability_type DEFENSE_REACTION on a Warrior ATTACK Reaction card — the wrong card type entirely, so it never fired. "Target WEAPON attack" -- the ability had no target filter at all, so it pumped ANY attack, not just a weapon attack. Found by sweeping cards whose text says "target weapon attack" for an ability with effects and no weapon filter.
